change_values_valid.name: change_values_valid
change_values_valid.value:
(kind <> 'changed' OR (old_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND new_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND old_value IS NOT NULL AND new_value IS NOT NULL)) AND
  (kind <> 'new' OR (old_source_id IS NULL AND old_snapshot_id IS NULL AND old_value IS NULL AND new_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND new_value IS NOT NULL))

idempotency_response_valid.name: idempotency_response_valid
idempotency_response_valid.value: response_code IS NULL OR response_code BETWEEN 100 AND 599

notification_report_required.name: notification_report_required
notification_report_required.value: kind = 'run_issue' OR report_id IS NOT NULL

run_sources_library_history.name: run_sources_library_history
run_sources_library_history.where: fetch_status = 'succeeded' AND snapshot_id IS NOT NULL

run_sources_library_latest.name: run_sources_library_latest
run_sources_library_latest.where: fetch_status = 'succeeded' AND snapshot_id IS NOT NULL

observation_result_valid.name: observation_result_valid
observation_result_valid.value: fetch_status <> 'succeeded' OR snapshot_id IS NOT NULL

run_complete_status_valid.name: run_complete_status_valid
run_complete_status_valid.value:
(status <> 'succeeded' OR COALESCE(coverage_json->>'completeness' = 'complete', false)) AND
  (status <> 'partial' OR COALESCE(coverage_json->>'completeness' = 'partial', false)) AND
  (outcome IS NULL OR outcome NOT IN ('baseline', 'no_important_change') OR (status = 'succeeded' AND COALESCE(coverage_json->>'completeness' = 'complete', false)))

run_json_shapes_valid.name: run_json_shapes_valid
run_json_shapes_valid.value:
jsonb_typeof(budget_json) = 'object'
  AND jsonb_typeof(usage_json) = 'object'
  AND (
    feedback_snapshot_json = '[]'::jsonb
    OR (
      jsonb_typeof(feedback_snapshot_json) = 'object'
      AND feedback_snapshot_json->'schemaVersion' = '1'::jsonb
      AND feedback_snapshot_json->>'userId' = user_id::text
      AND feedback_snapshot_json->>'taskId' = task_id::text
      AND jsonb_typeof(feedback_snapshot_json->'items') = 'array'
    )
  ) IS TRUE

search_configuration_api_complete.name: search_configuration_api_complete
search_configuration_api_complete.value: ("search_configurations"."protocol" IS NULL AND "search_configurations"."base_url" IS NULL AND "search_configurations"."content_mode" IS NULL AND "search_configurations"."encrypted_api_key" IS NULL AND "search_configurations"."default_mode" = 'searxng') OR ("search_configurations"."protocol" IS NOT NULL AND "search_configurations"."protocol" IN ('deepseek', 'perplexity', 'tavily') AND "search_configurations"."base_url" IS NOT NULL AND length("search_configurations"."base_url") > 0 AND "search_configurations"."content_mode" IS NOT NULL AND "search_configurations"."content_mode" IN ('reader', 'prefer_api') AND "search_configurations"."encrypted_api_key" IS NOT NULL AND length("search_configurations"."encrypted_api_key") > 0)

source_snapshots_expired_body.name: source_snapshots_expired_body
source_snapshots_expired_body.where: text_body IS NOT NULL AND text_expires_at IS NOT NULL

task_version_valid.name: task_version_valid
task_version_valid.value: version >= 1 AND config_schema_version = 1 AND comparison_scope_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof(config_json) = 'object'
